data: Introduction to two dimensional NMR spectrscopy

This course provides an introduction to the principles and applications of two-dimensional (2D) nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectroscopy. Students will learn the theoretical foundations of 2D NMR, including the concepts of spin interactions, coherence transfer, and pulse sequences. The course will cover key techniques such as COSY, HSQC, HMBC, and NOESY, with a focus on their utility in structural elucidation of organic and biomolecular compounds. Through a combination of lectures and problem-solving sessions, students will develop the ability to interpret 2D NMR spectra and apply these methods to solve complex structural problems in chemistry and biology.
